datenschutz.title: Privacy Policy
datenschutz.s1Text: The data controller within the meaning of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) is the operator of this website. Contact details can be found on the Imprint page.
datenschutz.s2Title: 2. Collection and Processing of Personal Data
datenschutz.s2Text: We only process personal data to the extent necessary for providing a functional website and our content and services. Personal data is only processed with user consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR) or when processing is necessary for the performance of a contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).
datenschutz.s3Text: Our insurance comparison can be used completely anonymously. No personal data is collected until you actively contact an advisor. Vehicle and driver information entered is only stored in an anonymous session that is automatically deleted after 24 hours.
datenschutz.s4Text: We use technically necessary cookies for session management. Functional and analytical cookies are only set after explicit consent. You can revoke your consent at any time via the cookie settings in the footer.
datenschutz.s5Text: IP addresses are stored exclusively in hashed form. A daily salt prevents traceability. Hashed IP addresses are used solely for protection against abuse (rate limiting).
datenschutz.s6Text: You have the right to information (Art. 15 GDPR), rectification (Art. 16 GDPR), erasure (Art. 17 GDPR), restriction of processing (Art. 18 GDPR), data portability (Art. 20 GDPR) and objection (Art. 21 GDPR). To exercise your rights, you can contact us at any time.
datenschutz.s7Text: For questions regarding data protection, please contact the data protection officer using the contact details provided in the Imprint.

agb.title: Terms and Conditions
agb.s1Text: These Terms and Conditions apply to the use of the car insurance comparison on this website. By using the website, you agree to these conditions.
agb.s2Text: We offer a free and anonymous comparison of car insurance tariffs. The displayed tariffs are for informational purposes only and do not constitute a binding offer. An insurance contract is only concluded through direct contact with an insurance advisor.
agb.s3Text: The insurance comparison does not constitute insurance advice. For individual advice, please contact a qualified insurance advisor through the provided contact channels.
agb.s4Text: We do not guarantee the accuracy, completeness and timeliness of the displayed tariffs and prices. Actual insurance premiums may differ from the displayed values.
agb.s5Text: Details on data processing can be found in our Privacy Policy.
agb.s6Text: We reserve the right to change these Terms and Conditions at any time. The changed conditions will be published on the website and apply from the date of publication.
